title: Potential Societal Biases of ChatGPT in Higher Education: A Scoping Review

bias_targets.methodology: Scoping review of 2023 academic literature on generative AI in higher education, categorizing papers that report or discuss biases related to gender roles, traits, and sexual identities.

Scoping review of academic literature on generative AI in higher education, identifying studies that discuss algorithmic stereotyping of occupational roles within academic and professional environments.

Scoping review of academic literature, extracting and analyzing papers that highlight racial discrimination or skewed associations in generative AI outputs applied to educational and research contexts.
Scoping review of academic literature tracking how often and in what context religious biases (e.g., valuing certain religions as superior) are reported in GAI tools used in higher education.
Scoping review of academic literature identifying mentions of prejudice or discrimination based on an individual's country of origin in GAI educational applications.

Analysis of selected literature revealing discriminatory tendencies in ChatGPT and AI detectors, specifically regarding the misidentification of non-native English writers' text as AI-generated and differing accuracy levels between languages.
